agreement_id.description: The agr_... id of the agreement. Example: agr_01926f3a-0000-7000-8000-000000000001

op.description: accept, counter or decline. Example: accept.

terms.description: Your counter terms. Needed only for op counter. Example: {"goal": "Review the checkout PR", "done_means": ["Findings listed"], "kinds": ["review"], "time_box_minutes": 1440, "budget_messages": 50}

if_revision.description: Integer 1 or more: the revision you read with agreement_get. Example: 1.
